conversion.patterns: Update8: nativeRGB extracted beforeencoding to restore materialdata underzeroalpha. Colorpatterns max1024px WebPquality90; normal/data512pxlossless; glovepattern/surface1024pxlossless; categoricalmasks native resolution lossless. Varyingnativealpha separate opaque losslessmap; constantalpha recordedin SKIN-TEXTURE-QUALITY.json. Optionalnativefolder retainsalloriginalshippedmapdimensions anddecodedRGBA; Source2compositing remainsapproximate.
conversion.models: Native viewmodel meshes, skeletal bone names preserved; glTF geometry, WebP textures, meshoptimizer. Gloves include both hands and forearms; replace the original arm mesh.
conversion.knifeAnimations: Native 5 clips per knife (idle, draw, light miss, heavy miss, inspect), exact 667-node canonical player rig order.

rarePools: Gun pools are read directly from client_loot_lists. Special pools are reconstructed by native knife/glove families and finish names; Valve server-side per-pattern weights are not supplied by the client schema. Browser draw probabilities must be labeled local rules.
